name: Scene Composer
description: Story-driven scene generator for the Fracture City world and animated show. Casts saved characters into a specific location at a specific time and composes a beat-by-beat immersive scene — sensory atmosphere, dialogue, internal experience, mood coded by the framework dimensions of the characters present. Each scene is a printable production document.

inputs.description: Cast members. The scene's emotional shape depends on the zone/stamp/capture mix of the characters in it.

outputs.description: Full scene record: setting, cast list, prose beats, dialogue, sensory atmosphere, production metadata.

author: Avner Media
